messages:
maya-ng: Heads-up — GreenPath usage dropped ~62% WoW and our primary contact (Lena, Product) left last Friday. Billing seats look steady but API calls & feature usage tanked. :eyes:

analytics-bot: automated alert — account=greenpath, usage_delta=-62%, drop_start=2026-03-10, top_impacted_endpoints=[/v1/generate,/v1/embed]

jared-evans: ugh. do we have recent support or incident history? any unresolved perf tickets?

maya-ng: Support shows two recent tickets about latency/regression that eng patched but we didn't run a proactive follow-up with the PO. Tickets: CS-4321, CS-4378. No executive outreach yet.

sofia-lee: Sales just flagged that procurement is asking for a PoC comparison vs CompetitorX — saw the email chain this morning. :frowning:

noah-sales: confirmed. procurement asked for a side-by-side and a trial. i'm trying to slow the cadence but need collateral. @jared-evans can you put together a quick competitive one-pager + PoC checklist?

jared-evans: on it. propose a tight 3-step retention play: 1) immediate exec touch + short credits to keep them in-platform, 2) 1-hr enablement for the new product owner + ops team, 3) technical perf runbook + quick-win prompt set.

ben-cs: agree with the play. recommend we also offer a 30-day Dedicated-trial discount (e.g., 50% off) to demonstrate latency SLAs — will need rev ops approval though.

maya-ng: i'll set the enablement session. can eng-runtime/ops join for perf Q&A? we should show reduced tail latency with their sample prompts.

eng-oncall: can join the enablement for up to 30 mins. also suggest we run a masked prompt eval before session.

sofia-lee: i'll coordinate with eng-oncall. maya, can you ask the PO for a sanitized prompt set? that makes the PoC credible.

maya-ng: asked the PO earlier; they said they'll send a sanitized set by EOD.

noah-sales: i'll tell procurement we have a comparison + pending PoC and ask for a 1-week extension on decisions. they sounded receptive.

jared-evans: drafting the one-pager now. will include a dashboard snapshot and a short perf table. quick query I pulled for the team:

```sql
SELECT date, sum(api_calls) as calls
FROM usage
WHERE account = 'greenpath'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 14;
```

ben-cs: nice. also capture recent ticket resolutions and link playbook templates. i'll draft the enablement slide deck.

maya-ng: owners: jared-evans -> playbook + one-pager, maya-ng -> enablement ops & customer comms, noah-sales -> procurement cadence. eng-oncall -> perf Q&A.

sofia-lee: logging this to CS tracker and adding a renewal-risk flag. next sync tomorrow 10:00am PT.

maya-ng: thanks all. immediate asks: jared (one-pager by EOD), eng-oncall (confirm availability for 10am), maya (schedule enablement invite). react with :thumbsup: when you have it.

noah-sales: :thumbsup: placing hold on procurement timeline; will escalate if we don't see traction by Friday.

analytics-bot: note: follow-up reminder created — greenpath: follow_up_due=2026-03-20T17:00:00Z

maya-ng: closing the loop — we need quick wins to retain them. will post updates after the deck and sanitized prompts arrive.
